sources.snippet: This is where Yi-Coder 1.5B fits into your workflow. Developed by 01.AI, Yi-Coder 1.5B is a specialized, small-language model (SLM) designed specifically for coding tasks. It targets developers who prioritize privacy, offline capability, or are working on hardware that can't support 70B+ parameter models.
